summary: A fake image appearing to show a former US president dancing with a young girl at a financier's private island circulated on social media. Fact-checkers and an image-forensics expert said it showed signs of generative AI.
technical_summary: A synthetic image made with a generative image model was shared on social media with captions implying real misconduct. Forensic experts identified artifacts such as extra fingers, inconsistent eye reflections and misshapen limbs.

summary: In China, several people used AI software to fabricate fake news of a landslide, an earthquake and a sudden death, then posted it online to gain traffic. Police fined or penalized those responsible.
technical_summary: Generative AI tools were used to write false news articles and generate fake disaster images, which were combined with real pictures and posted on platforms for traffic and platform rewards. Authorities imposed administrative penalties on the posters.

summary: A man was arrested for armed robberies after a retailer's facial recognition system reportedly matched him to surveillance footage, though he was far away at the time. He says he was assaulted in jail before charges were dropped.
